description:
Trigger a build compilation for an app draft. Sends the full config as multipart/form-data to the build queue (exactly like the web frontend does).

The user MUST have an existing draft saved via nativine_save_draft first. The backend reads the draft config and enforces all plan/addon restrictions server-side.

For AAB (Android App Bundle) target, the user must be on the Release plan. Free plan builds produce a trial APK (valid 48 hours). Release plan builds produce production-ready APKs/AABs.

Returns a buildId which can be used with nativine_build_status to track progress.

draftId.description: Draft ID. Reads from .nativine/config.json if omitted.

target.description: Build target format. apk (default) or aab (Release plan only)

name: nativine_trigger_build
